limits: 32 positives in 123 cells makes the AUC variance large; bootstrap CIs are reported.
No feature search was performed, to avoid overfitting the 32 positives.
Tissue has only three levels, so it contributes at most a small offset.
Retrospective; no mechanism, clinical or drug-choice claim; no meta-learning or RSI.

practical_reading.auc_vs_precision_gap: the LOO AUC is 0.789 but precision never exceeds about 0.50 at any threshold, against a 0.26 base rate. The model ranks well but does not separate cleanly, so 'flag as never-benefiting' is wrong about half the time.
practical_reading.what_it_is_good_for: triage: at threshold 0.2 it flags 55% of cells and captures 94% of the truly never-benefiting ones, so it can prioritise which cells to skip when measuring is expensive
practical_reading.what_it_is_not_good_for: certifying that a given cell will not benefit - precision 0.44-0.50 is too low for an exclusion rule
